messages.subject: New GGIR any local expert in Newcastle, UK
parts: Hello. Thanks for all experts who put their time and effort in creating such great package.  I am a PhD student here in Newcastle University. Newcastle, UK. I use Geneactive watch with my research. I have tried following the instructions provided in the web-page and in many questions here, but I am still lacking experience with R and R studio as my background is not related to computer sciences. Is there any expert in Newcastle? I should be a quick learner.

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] New GGIR any local expert in Newcastle, UK
parts:
Hi Maher,
If you could time travel 4 years in the past it would be me (I used to be in Newcastle, UK).
Before I left I gave a GGIR introduction workshop at the Digital Institute. I suppose the people who attended may have moved on already.
Possibly Mike and Chris Catt are able to help a bit, if they have time.
Further, you can of course post your questions here or if it is a more specific issue here: https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/issues. In that way others with the same questions and issues can learn from the answers you get.
Best, Vincent
